// Package retry runs a function until it succeeds or the attempts run out.
//
// Fixture for the token estimator tests: idiomatic Go with tabs,
// interfaces, goroutines, channels and a table-driven test.
package retry

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"math/rand"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

// ErrGiveUp is returned when every attempt has failed.
var ErrGiveUp = errors.New("retry: all attempts failed")

// Policy describes how long to wait between attempts.
type Policy struct {
	Attempts   int
	BaseDelay  time.Duration
	MaxDelay   time.Duration
	Multiplier float64
	Jitter     bool
}

// DefaultPolicy is a sensible starting point for network calls.
var DefaultPolicy = Policy{
	Attempts:   5,
	BaseDelay:  100 * time.Millisecond,
	MaxDelay:   5 * time.Second,
	Multiplier: 2.0,
	Jitter:     true,
}

func (p Policy) delay(attempt int) time.Duration {
	d := float64(p.BaseDelay)
	for i := 1; i < attempt; i++ {
		d *= p.Multiplier
	}
	if max := float64(p.MaxDelay); d > max {
		d = max
	}
	if p.Jitter {
		d = d/2 + rand.Float64()*d/2
	}
	return time.Duration(d)
}

// Do calls fn until it returns nil, the context is cancelled,
// or the policy is exhausted.
func Do(ctx context.Context, p Policy, fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
	var last error
	for attempt := 1; attempt <= p.Attempts; attempt++ {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if last = fn(ctx); last == nil {
			return nil
		}
		if attempt == p.Attempts {
			break
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return ctx.Err()
		case <-time.After(p.delay(attempt)):
		}
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("%w after %d attempts: %v", ErrGiveUp, p.Attempts, last)
}

// Result pairs the name of a job with its outcome.
type Result struct {
	Name string
	Err  error
}

// All runs every job concurrently with the same policy and collects the results.
func All(ctx context.Context, p Policy, jobs map[string]func(context.Context) error) []Result {
	var (
		wg      sync.WaitGroup
		mu      sync.Mutex
		results = make([]Result, 0, len(jobs))
	)
	for name, job := range jobs {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(name string, job func(context.Context) error) {
			defer wg.Done()
			err := Do(ctx, p, job)
			mu.Lock()
			results = append(results, Result{Name: name, Err: err})
			mu.Unlock()
		}(name, job)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	return results
}

// --- test file contents below (kept in one fixture for convenience) ---

type flaky struct{ failures int }

func (f *flaky) call(context.Context) error {
	if f.failures > 0 {
		f.failures--
		return errors.New("temporary failure")
	}
	return nil
}

func exampleTable() {
	cases := []struct {
		name     string
		failures int
		attempts int
		wantErr  bool
	}{
		{"succeeds immediately", 0, 3, false},
		{"succeeds on last attempt", 2, 3, false},
		{"gives up", 5, 3, true},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		f := &flaky{failures: tc.failures}
		p := Policy{Attempts: tc.attempts, BaseDelay: time.Millisecond, Multiplier: 1}
		err := Do(context.Background(), p, f.call)
		if (err != nil) != tc.wantErr {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: got err=%v, wantErr=%t", tc.name, err, tc.wantErr))
		}
	}
}
